tools.name: recall
tools.description: Returns what DeNasty remembers about a project (decisions, conventions, context, open tasks, notes), newest first. Optional text query and kind filter. Omit project to search across all projects.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Saves one memory for a project so every AI tool of this user sees it later. Use for decisions (and why), conventions, important context, open tasks. Keep it short and self-contained. Secrets are removed automatically.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists the projects DeNasty has memory for, with counts and last update.

tools.name: project_brief
tools.description: Returns the project's memory as a Markdown section ready to paste into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or Cursor rules.

tools.name: my_preferences
tools.description: Returns the user's confirmed personal preferences and writing rules that they allowed to share with AI tools.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Deletes one memory by id (from recall). Cannot be undone.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "remember" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
